data.narrative: In Module 07 (Security & Architecture Review), Alekhya stepped into the Tech Lead persona, executing a comprehensive system-level security and architectural audit across all code generated in Modules 02-06. Utilizing an AI-assisted hybrid review strategy, she mapped all endpoints across auth, authorization, input validation, and IDOR surfaces. She caught the critical privilege escalation vulnerability where membership checking was conflated with role authorization on PUT /teams/:id/members/:uid, allowing viewers to escalate to admin. She specified and implemented six explicit security constraints—including non-self-modification, strict role enum validation, owner-only promotions, and audit event emission—and verified the fix with 13 exhaustive security test cases, elevating the test suite to 51/51 passing tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored production-grade security fix specifications with 6 explicit negative and positive constraints, preventing ambiguous code generation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented exact requirements (isTeamAdminOrOwner, non-self modification, role enum whitelist, owner promotion guard, audit logging) implemented cleanly in src/routes/teams.js.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed comprehensive auth check, input validation, IDOR, secrets, and test coverage maps in progress/security-architecture-review.md, identifying the composable vulnerability chain.
dimension_scores.evidence: Audited all 13 system endpoints and input parameters, flagging the critical role update privilege escalation before exploitation.

dimension_scores.observation: Remediated the BFLA privilege escalation flaw in a single turn without breaking existing routes or test assertions.
dimension_scores.evidence: Maintained 100% backward compatibility with all starter and feature tests while adding 13 dedicated security test cases.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected Option B (ai_assisted_hybrid) to balance brute-force pattern coverage against human focus on the critical auth and mutation paths, recognizing that AI scanners miss contextual semantics.
dimension_scores.evidence: Reasoned that AI checks syntax and structure while human engineers must validate authorization semantics and business logic intent.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered a hardened, enterprise-grade membership and role update subsystem with negative RBAC tests and immutable audit trail emission.
dimension_scores.evidence: 51 passing unit, integration, and security tests running cleanly in tests/*.test.js in 353ms.

strengths: System-level threat modeling: recognizes that secure isolated functions can compose into catastrophic multi-hop vulnerabilities.
Rigorous privilege analysis: uncovers Broken Function Level Authorization (BFLA) gaps and enforces least privilege access control.
Negative test engineering: constructs exhaustive boundary and negative authorization test cases (13 test matrix) to prevent security regressions.
